Hi, I’m Gabriella Hasian, a Master of Data Science student at the University of British Columbia with a background in Actuarial Science and several years of experience in credit decisioning. Before pursuing my MDS, I worked in banking, where I focused on using data and analytics to support credit risk and portfolio management. This experience sparked my interest in applying data science to real-world problems and using data to drive better decisions. I’m now looking to deepen my expertise in data science and explore opportunities at the intersection of data, technology, and finance.
